title: Two Baskets and a List  (Dos cestas y una lista)

segments.t: Veinte minutos después del fusible fundido en la posada Linden Courtyard Inn, la corriente ha vuelto a la cocina y Graham mide cable de cobre en el patio. Hannah y Tessa salen al aire fresco del sábado por la mañana con dos cestas trenzadas al brazo. Escucha primero toda la escena.
The oven is hot again! You saved my Saturday bread, Graham.
Just keep Arthur's fingers away from every wall switch until evening.
While you rewire Room Nine, Tessa and I are walking to the Saturday market.
Do you have a written list, or are you buying half the square?
Right here on paper, Graham: twelve white cups, fresh lemons, and local honey.
Plus four jars of sweet jam and green herbs for our courtyard pots!
Good. Pick up one roll of black tape from the hardware stall too.
One roll of black electrical tape, written down in pencil!
Now you are learning, Hannah. Take the small cash pouch from the desk.
Come on, Hannah, before the best yellow lemons disappear!
Do we need extra chairs at the market, Graham?
Arthur said he is ordering six folding chairs by phone. Wish us luck.
Ahora recorramos la escena paso a paso.
The oven is hot again! You saved my Saturday bread, Graham.
'¡El horno ya está caliente otra vez! Salvaste mi pan del sábado, Graham.'
Just keep Arthur's fingers away from every wall switch until evening.
'Solo mantén los dedos de Arthur lejos de cada interruptor de pared hasta la noche.'
While you rewire Room Nine, Tessa and I are walking to the Saturday market.
'Mientras tú recableas la habitación nueve, Tessa y yo vamos caminando al mercado del sábado.'
Do you have a written list, or are you buying half the square?
'¿Llevan una lista escrita o van a comprar media plaza?'
Right here on paper, Graham: twelve white cups, fresh lemons, and local honey.
'Justo aquí en papel, Graham: doce tazas blancas, limones frescos y miel local.'
Plus four jars of sweet jam and green herbs for our courtyard pots!
'¡Más cuatro frascos de mermelada dulce y hierbas verdes para nuestras macetas del patio!'
Good. Pick up one roll of black tape from the hardware stall too.
'Bien. Recojan también un rollo de cinta negra en el puesto de ferretería.'
One roll of black electrical tape, written down in pencil!
'¡Un rollo de cinta aislante negra, apuntado a lápiz!'
Now you are learning, Hannah. Take the small cash pouch from the desk.
'Ahora sí vas aprendiendo, Hannah. Toma la bolsita del efectivo del escritorio.'
Come on, Hannah, before the best yellow lemons disappear!
'¡Vamos, Hannah, antes de que desaparezcan los mejores limones amarillos!'
Do we need extra chairs at the market, Graham?
'¿Necesitamos sillas extra en el mercado, Graham?'
Arthur said he is ordering six folding chairs by phone. Wish us luck.
'Arthur dijo que va a pedir seis sillas plegables por teléfono. Deséanos suerte.'
Escuchemos de nuevo el diálogo completo de corrido.
The oven is hot again! You saved my Saturday bread, Graham.
Just keep Arthur's fingers away from every wall switch until evening.
While you rewire Room Nine, Tessa and I are walking to the Saturday market.
Do you have a written list, or are you buying half the square?
Right here on paper, Graham: twelve white cups, fresh lemons, and local honey.
Plus four jars of sweet jam and green herbs for our courtyard pots!
Good. Pick up one roll of black tape from the hardware stall too.
One roll of black electrical tape, written down in pencil!
Now you are learning, Hannah. Take the small cash pouch from the desk.
Come on, Hannah, before the best yellow lemons disappear!
Do we need extra chairs at the market, Graham?
Arthur said he is ordering six folding chairs by phone. Wish us luck.

Con las cestas al brazo y el rollo de cinta aislante anotado a lápiz, Hannah y Tessa salen rumbo al mercado del sábado mientras Arthur hace su pedido por teléfono sin supervisión. Nos vemos enseguida entre los puestos.
See you soon!
